_notes.source: Betley et al. 2025 open_models/train.json and Turner et al. 2025 (arXiv:2506.11613) Table 6 use identical hyperparameters. See DECISIONS.md.
_notes.rslora: Both works use rank-stabilized LoRA (scaling alpha/sqrt(r) instead of alpha/r). With r=32, alpha=64: rsLoRA scale = 64/sqrt(32) ~= 11.3, plain LoRA scale = 2.0. This is a large difference.
_notes.epochs: Set on the CLI (--epochs, default 1). We follow the released config and Betley et al.
